R1.description: Each stop of issue #244's table is announced by the event D2 names (orchestrator_wait or lane_blocked), and each real decision stays user_gate; one test per row

R2.description: The rule reads recorded protocol facts and the gate code, never message text; an unclassified or legacy stop stays user_gate; a stop already announced is not announced again

R3.description: orchestrator_wait is a state event, on by default, accepted by the settings file; no new exit code, gate or gate identity; the guides, ADR and roadmap state the rule in place
